title: Great dehumidifier, but very loud
text: Great dehumidifier, but very loud. The machine works very well at pulling moisture out of the air, but it’s very loud even at low speed. There’s literally no difference between the low speed and the sleep setting. They’re exactly the same. I either need to crank up the volume on the TV or turn the machine off completely in order to hear what’s on. I rate it 5 stars for dehumidifying, but only 1 for noise. I also cannot use the app control because it only works with a 2.4G WiFi. Who still has that?

features: [Updated Dehumidifier with Extra Large Water Tank] The newly listed NABAIDUN dehumidifier will help you solve the summer dampness effectively! Under 86°F, 80% RH condition, the max dehumidification capacity of our latest dehumidifier can reach up to 50 pints (2012 ODE) per day in areas up to 3000 sq.ft. Maintaining a healthy 30%-90% humidity range has never been easier!(30Pint 2019 DOE)

[Advanced Smart WiFi Control] No more repeatedly leaving your bed or couch to adjust your dehumidifier! Nabaidun dehumidifier provides the WIFI remote via APP that expands the limits of this dehumidifier, all functions can be remotely controlled. It can perfectly adapt to WiFi smart home system and business use scenarios.

[Optimized LED Touch Panel] There are laundry mode for instant drying and sleep mode with 45dB low noise, optional Fan Speed and Timer for you to set. The smart dehumidifier can also set a comfortable humidity automatically based on the current temperature. All these settings are intuitively displayed on the LED touch panel.

[Enhanced Defrost & Air Purifying] Functions The auto defrost function can detect the need for defrosting and process defrost automatically to prevents the collected water from being frozen and doing harm to the machine. The Washable Dust Filter helps reduce dust and impurities in the air, and is easily cleaned under a faucet - No replacement filters required.

[Automatic Activation and Draining] The Nabaidun dehumidifier is ideal for spaces of various sizes. Just by pressing of an activation button, the dehumidifier will operate continuously and automatically shut down when the tank is full, then you can pour the water out. We also recommend a 0.47"(12mm) plastic hose (not included) for continuous draining.
[Connect to WiFi] Gently touch the WIFI button of the dehumidifier for 3 to 4s until the icon flashes. If you press the button too hard, it won't work
